news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% YoY to $1.93M (H1 revenue $3.6M, up 98%), driven by expanded payer coverage following the Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026; gross margin improved to 85.9% and cash stood at $8.3M, but EPS loss of $0.19 missed the $0.16 forecast and shares fell on the print.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy, adding incremental access in the Mid-Atlantic region and bringing total covered lives under new policies to over 500,000.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: The company confirmed it would release Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00 a.m. ET to review results and provide a business update.

news.headline: NeurAxis, Inc. Declares Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board declared its Q2 2026 stock dividend (8.5% cumulative annual rate) on Series B Preferred Stock, issuing roughly 80,456 common shares to preferred holders of record as of July 21, 2026, paid July 29, 2026.

catalysts.label: Larger payer/insurance accounts
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 call it expects to sign larger insurance coverage accounts in the second half of 2026 into 2027, a key driver for reaching profitability, though it declined to give specific timing.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and business-update call, following the established pattern of reporting roughly two weeks into the month after quarter-end.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company is actively pursuing additional regional medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim on top of the >500,000 covered lives added in August 2026.

catalysts.label: Sales/clinical/policy team expansion
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis guided that operating expenses will rise in H2 2026 as it continues hiring sales, marketing, clinical and policy staff to capture payer-coverage-driven demand.

pulse: NeurAxis delivered another quarter of triple-digit revenue growth (Q2 2026 revenue +116% YoY to $1.93M) as the Category I CPT code for PENFS and expanding payer coverage (now over 500,000 newly covered lives) drive unit and pricing gains, though the company remains unprofitable and posted a wider-than-expected per-share loss. Management describes a shift from an "access-creation" phase to an "execution" phase, with the next inflection tied to landing larger insurance accounts in H2 2026/2027. With roughly $8.3M cash on hand and rising operating expenses from continued commercial hiring, the near-term story is about sustaining the reimbursement-driven growth trajectory into the next quarterly report.
